text:
Ilya Sorokin was one of the league's best goalies last season, 22.3 goals saved above expected in 55 games by our count (goals he stopped beyond what an average goalie would on those shots). He's at it again: 10.76 through 16 starts, 87th percentile per 60 minutes, with a 9-5-2 record and a .916 save percentage. CBS Sports logged his third straight win in Detroit on Nov. 21.

Monday against Toronto showed the other side. A third-period goal tied it, and NHL.com's Stefen Rosner wrote "Sorokin wasn't screened, just didn't catch it." Toronto's winner came on a rebound after a save, and Sorokin went to the bench with 2:11 left in a 3-2 loss. His split by danger explains the season: he's far better than average on low-danger shots (.981 against .962) and medium ones (.906 against .861), and slightly below on high danger (.672 against .684). He ranks ninth among 79 goalies in our wins added through saves. Rebounds are worth watching, with 12% of his saves followed by another shot within three seconds.
headline: Ilya Sorokin keeps saving the Islanders
